supporting_article_titles: Flexport launches MCP Server for AI agents to book freight

raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: shipment request → rate search → booking → tracking → exception/customs handling
raw_opportunities.target_customer: freight forwarders, shippers and logistics teams adopting AI agents
raw_opportunities.buyer: logistics operations manager or digital transformation lead
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: allow AI agents to execute freight actions without losing approval, policy and exception control
raw_opportunities.current_friction: agent-initiated bookings can cross financial and operational boundaries while evidence, authority and exception ownership remain fragmented
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: carrier-neutral agent freight approval desk with action limits, booking approval rules, exception queue and audit ledger
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: AI agentların navlun teklifi ve rezervasyon işlemlerini yetki, onay ve istisna kurallarıyla yöneten bağımsız operasyon masası.
